name.pt-BR: O Ofício da Paixão do Senhor

description.la: Officium rhythmicum de passione Domini per horas canonicas, a Matutino ad Completorium. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Decem opuscula, 1900), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A rhymed Office of the Lord’s Passion through the canonical hours, from Matins to Compline. The Latin is the Quaracchi text of the Decem opuscula (1900), from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Ofício rimado da Paixão do Senhor através das horas canônicas, das Matinas às Completas.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Decem opuscula ad theologiam mysticam spectantia, ed. 2 (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1900).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR of the octavo edition. Page heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings and cross-references) and note markers are removed; line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by comparison with the other Quaracchi scans, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1900 is public domain.
